gloss: secret plan; secret strategy; trump card

definitions.gloss: secret plan; secret strategy; hidden trump card
definitions.explanation: A plan or strategy kept hidden until the right moment. Implies a clever or decisive measure that others do not expect.

examples.japanese: {秘策|ひさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a secret plan prepared.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{秘策|ひさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}っていた→練る：09751_neru⟧。
examples.english: The coach was devising a secret strategy to win the game.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低迷|ていめい}→低迷：09332_teimei⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}した→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧{秘策|ひさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}した→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧。
examples.english: Sales had been sluggish, but thanks to the secret strategy the president unveiled, business performance recovered.

notes:
A compound of {秘|ひ} (secret; hidden) and ⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧ (plan; strategy). Often used in dramatic or emphatic contexts — sports, business, storytelling — to describe a plan that turns the tide. The word carries a positive connotation, implying cleverness and foresight.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秘策|ひさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧: to devise a secret plan
- {秘策|ひさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あ}かす→明かす：12961_akasu⟧: to reveal a secret plan
- {秘策|ひさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧: to prepare a secret strategy
- {秘策|ひさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}す→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧: to put forward a secret strategy
- ⟦とっておき→とっておき：10472_totteoki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{秘策|ひさく}: an ace up one's sleeve

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{作戦|さくせん}→作戦：09673_sakusen⟧: strategy; tactics — a general plan of action, not necessarily secret
- {奥|おく}の{手|て}: trump card; last resort — a hidden technique or measure saved for a critical moment
- ⟦{裏技|うらわざ}→裏技：14021_urawaza⟧: hidden trick; secret technique — a lesser-known method, often in games or daily life
